title: Backend Developer
description: Design robust server architectures, distributed databases, scalable REST/gRPC APIs, microservices, and secure transaction workflows.

goal.objective: Architect resilient server-side services, high-throughput data processing pipelines, and mission-critical APIs that power modern digital platforms.

learn.summary: Master server-side runtimes (Node.js, Go, Python, Java), relational and document databases, caching strategies, containerization, and message queues.

capstone_projects.title: Distributed Event-Driven Order Processing Engine
capstone_projects.description: Architect an idempotent payment and order state machine handling concurrent checkouts with distributed locking.

capstone_projects.title: High-Concurrency URL Shortener & Analytics Gateway
capstone_projects.description: Build an analytics proxy capable of processing 10,000 req/sec with bloom filters, rate limiting, and GeoIP routing.

certifications: Linux Foundation Certified Node.js Services Developer (JSNSD)
interview_focus: System Design (Rate Limiting, URL Shortener, Chat Systems)

tree.name: Core Fundamentals & Programming Languages
tree.description: Establish a strong foundation in computer science principles and choose a primary programming language ecosystem for backend development.

resources.title: What is Backend Development? A Complete Guide
Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C# - Which Backend Framework To Choose?

children.name: Programming Basics & OOP
children.description: Master essential programming concepts, including variables, control flow, functions, object-oriented programming (OOP) principles (encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism), and functional programming basics for writing maintainable and scalable backend code.

resources.title: Python Full Course for Beginners Tutorial

children.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
children.description: Understand common data structures (arrays, linked lists, trees, hash maps, heaps, graphs) and algorithms (searching, sorting, graph traversal, dynamic programming) and analyze their time/space complexity (Big O notation).

resources.title: Data Structures and Algorithms Course (freeCodeCamp.org / MIT OCW)

children.name: Version Control (Git & GitHub)
children.description: Learn to manage code changes, collaborate with teams, and use Git for version control and GitHub for repository hosting, including branching, merging, pull requests, and resolving conflicts.

resources.title: Git and GitHub for Beginners - Crash Course (freeCodeCamp)
Git & GitHub Crash Course From Scratch

children.name: Linux & Command Line Basics
children.description: Familiarize yourself with basic Linux commands, file system navigation, permissions, process management, and basic shell scripting, essential for server management and development environments.

children.name: Python Backend Development
children.description: Master Python for backend services, from core language features to popular web frameworks and asynchronous programming.

resources.title: Python Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
Python Flask Tutorial | Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Django: Full-Stack Web Framework
children.description: Learn Django's 'batteries-included' approach for rapid development, covering ORM, Admin panel, authentication, templating, and REST API creation with Django REST Framework.

resources.title: Python Django Tutorial: Full-Featured Web App Part 1 (Corey Schafer)
Django Full Course - Python Web Framework for Beginners

children.name: Flask: Lightweight Micro-Framework
children.description: Explore Flask for building simpler APIs and web services, focusing on routing, request handling, blueprints, and integrating with extensions for databases and authentication.

resources.title: Learn Flask for Python - Full Tutorial (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: FastAPI: Modern & Asynchronous
children.description: Dive into FastAPI for high-performance APIs, leveraging Python type hints, Pydantic for data validation, dependency injection, WebSockets, and automatic OpenAPI documentation.

children.name: Node.js Backend Development
children.description: Build scalable and high-performance backend applications using JavaScript/TypeScript with Node.js and its robust ecosystem.

resources.title: Getting Started with Express and NodeJS (Piyush Garg)
Node.js & Express.js - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: JavaScript/TypeScript Fundamentals
children.description: Solidify your understanding of modern JavaScript features (ES6+), asynchronous programming (Promises, Async/Await), event loop, Node.js runtime, and TypeScript for type-safe code, along with `npm/yarn` for package management.

resources.title: JavaScript Crash Course for Beginners (Traversy Media)

children.name: Express.js: Minimalist Web Framework
children.description: Learn Express.js for building RESTful APIs, focusing on middleware, routing, handling HTTP requests and responses efficiently, and integrating with database drivers.

children.name: NestJS: Enterprise-Grade Framework
children.description: Explore NestJS for building scalable, maintainable, and testable applications with TypeScript, leveraging its modular architecture, dependency injection, decorators, microservice capabilities, and robust CLI.

resources.title: NestJS Full Course - Build an API with NestJS and Prisma

children.name: Java Backend Development
children.description: Delve into enterprise-grade backend development with Java, focusing on core language features, the JVM, and the Spring Boot ecosystem.

resources.title: Spring Boot Tutorial for Beginners (Full Course)

children.name: Core Java & JVM
children.description: Understand core Java concepts including OOP, Collections API, Concurrency (threads, executors), Generics, I/O, Exception Handling, and the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) architecture and memory management.

resources.title: Java Tutorial for Beginners (Programming with Mosh)
Java Tutorial for Beginners - Learn Java in 12 Hours

children.name: Spring Boot: Industry Standard
children.description: Master Spring Boot for building robust and production-ready applications, covering Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, REST Controllers, and dependency injection.

tree.name: Data Management & Storage
tree.description: Understand various database types, data modeling, querying, and optimization techniques crucial for persistent and scalable data storage.

resources.title: SQL vs NoSQL Databases Explained - What is a Relational Database and Non-Relational Database?

children.name: Database Design & Schema
children.description: Learn principles of database design, including Entity-Relationship (ER) diagrams, relational schema design, normalization forms (1NF, 2NF, 3NF), indexing strategies, and schema migration tools.

resources.title: Database Design Tutorial for Beginners (Alex the Analyst)
Database Design Course for Beginners - Learn how to design and plan a database for a web application

children.name: Relational Databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
children.description: Master SQL for querying and managing relational databases, focusing on PostgreSQL and MySQL, including complex joins, subqueries, transactions, stored procedures, and performance tuning.

resources.title: SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)

children.name: NoSQL Databases (MongoDB & Types)
children.description: Explore NoSQL database paradigms including document (MongoDB), key-value (Redis), column-family (Cassandra), and graph databases (Neo4j), understanding their use cases, data models, and advantages over relational databases.

resources.title: MongoDB Tutorial for Beginners - Full Course (freeCodeCamp.org)
What is MongoDB? NoSQL explained in 13 minutes

children.name: Caching Systems (Redis)
children.description: Implement caching strategies using in-memory data stores like Redis for improving application performance, reducing database load, session management, leaderboards, and real-time features. Understand cache invalidation and eviction policies.

resources.title: Redis Tutorial - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Message Queues & Brokers
children.description: Understand asynchronous communication patterns using message queues like RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, or AWS SQS/GCP Pub/Sub for decoupling services, handling background tasks, building event-driven systems, and ensuring reliable data delivery.

children.name: Database Scaling & Replication
children.description: Learn about strategies for scaling databases, including horizontal and vertical scaling, replication (master-slave, multi-master), sharding, partitioning, and load balancing for high availability and performance.

tree.name: API Design & Communication
tree.description: Learn to design, build, and secure APIs that enable seamless and efficient communication between different services and clients.

resources.title: What is a REST API? (IBM Technology)
REST API Crash Course - Design, Principles, and Best Practices
What is GraphQL? - A Beginner's Guide

children.name: RESTful API Principles
children.description: Master the principles of REST, including HTTP methods, status codes, resource-based design, statelessness, idempotency, versioning, pagination, filtering, and HATEOAS. Learn to structure requests and responses effectively.

resources.title: What is REST API? Understanding RESTful APIs | MERN Stack

children.name: GraphQL APIs
children.description: Explore GraphQL as an alternative to REST, focusing on its query language, schema definition language (SDL), resolvers, mutations, subscriptions for real-time data, and Apollo Client/Server integration.

resources.title: GraphQL Tutorial for Beginners | Learn GraphQL from scratch

children.name: gRPC (Remote Procedure Calls)
children.description: Understand gRPC for high-performance, language-agnostic communication using Protocol Buffers for efficient data serialization and HTTP/2 for stream-based microservices interaction.

children.name: API Security & Authentication
children.description: Implement secure authentication (JWT, OAuth2, session management, API keys) and authorization mechanisms (RBAC, ABAC). Understand common vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, CSRF), input validation, password hashing (bcrypt), and rate limiting.

resources.title: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (in plain English)

children.name: API Gateways & Proxies
children.description: Learn how API Gateways (e.g., Nginx, Kong, AWS API Gateway) manage routing, traffic management, rate limiting, authentication, logging, and aggregation for multiple backend services, enhancing security and manageability.

resources.title: What is an API Gateway? (IBM Technology)

children.name: API Documentation (OpenAPI/Swagger)
children.description: Generate and maintain interactive API documentation using standards like OpenAPI (Swagger) for clear communication with API consumers, ensuring easy understanding and integration.

resources.title: Documenting Your API with OpenAPI and Swagger (Postman)
OpenAPI and Swagger Tutorial - How to document your API

tree.name: Deployment, DevOps & Cloud
tree.description: Acquire the skills to deploy, manage, monitor, and scale backend applications in production environments, leveraging cloud services and DevOps practices.

resources.title: What is DevOps? Full Course for Beginners
Docker Crash Course | Containers, Images, Volumes, Networking and more!

children.name: Containerization (Docker)
children.description: Containerize applications using Docker to ensure consistent environments across development, testing, and production. Learn Dockerfile creation, image management, volumes, networking, and Docker Compose for multi-container applications.

resources.title: Docker Crash Course for Absolute Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
Docker Compose Tutorial - Build a Multi-Container App

children.name: Container Orchestration (Kubernetes Basics)
children.description: Get an introduction to Kubernetes for automating deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications. Understand core concepts like Pods, Deployments, Services, and Namespaces.

children.name: Cloud Platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
children.description: Learn to deploy and manage backend services on major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), focusing on compute (EC2/GCE/VMs), storage (S3/GCS/Blob Storage), networking (VPC/VNet), IAM, and basic managed database services (RDS/Cloud SQL).

resources.title: Microsoft Azure Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Serverless Computing
children.description: Explore serverless architectures using services like AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions, or Azure Functions to build event-driven, cost-effective, and highly scalable APIs and backend tasks.

resources.title: AWS Lambda Tutorial for Beginners - Deploy a Serverless API

children.name: CI/CD Pipelines
children.description: Set up Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or CircleCI for automated testing, building, and deployment, ensuring rapid and reliable releases.

resources.title: CI/CD In 10 Minutes | What Is CI/CD, How It Works & Why It's Used

children.name: Monitoring, Logging & Alerting
children.description: Implement comprehensive monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog), centralized logging (ELK stack, Splunk, CloudWatch, Stackdriver), and alerting systems (PagerDuty, custom notifications) for production applications to ensure reliability and quick issue resolution.

resources.title: Learn Prometheus and Grafana - Full Course for Beginners
Elastic Stack Course - Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana Tutorial

children.name: Web Servers & Reverse Proxies
children.description: Configure and manage web servers like Nginx or Apache, understanding their role as reverse proxies, load balancers, SSL termination points, and for static content serving. Learn about proxy configuration and caching.

resources.title: Nginx Crash Course | Learn Nginx for Web Development

tree.name: Advanced Architecture & Practical Projects
tree.description: Explore advanced architectural patterns, design principles, and apply all learned knowledge to build complex, production-ready backend systems.

resources.title: Microservices Master Class - Deploy to the Cloud with Docker & Kubernetes

children.name: Microservices Architecture
children.description: Understand the concepts, benefits, and challenges of designing and building microservices-based applications, including service discovery, inter-service communication patterns (sync/async), data consistency, and distributed transactions.

resources.title: Microservices Crash Course - Part 1 - What are Microservices?

children.name: System Design Principles
children.description: Learn to design scalable, reliable, and fault-tolerant distributed systems. Cover topics like CAP theorem, consistency models (strong, eventual), availability patterns, load balancing, sharding, and various architectural patterns for large-scale applications.

children.name: Event-Driven Architecture
children.description: Explore building reactive systems using event sourcing, CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation), and event streams. Understand concepts like sagas, eventual consistency, and how message brokers facilitate highly scalable and responsive systems.

children.name: Backend Security Best Practices
children.description: Implement industry-standard security practices, including secure coding guidelines, input validation, encryption (TLS, data at rest), secure configuration, vulnerability scanning, and understanding the OWASP API Security Top 10 and common attack vectors.

resources.title: Web Security Basics - Frontend and Backend

children.name: Advanced Testing Strategies
children.description: Develop comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, end-to-end, performance (load testing), security testing, and contract testing for robust backend applications. Learn about test doubles (mocks, stubs) and test coverage tools.

resources.title: Unit, Integration, and End-to-End Testing Explained

children.name: Practice: API Hardening Drill
children.description: Apply security and reliability principles to an existing API by adding robust input validation, pagination, rate limiting, advanced error handling, comprehensive structured logging, robust authentication and authorization checks, and preparing it for production deployment.

resources.title: Building a Robust API with Error Handling (Flask Example)
API Security Tutorial for Beginners | Best Practices & Real-World Examples
Rate Limiting with Node.js, Express & Redis

children.name: Project: Production-Ready Backend API
children.description: Build and deploy a fully documented REST API (or GraphQL/gRPC) for a complex application. Incorporate advanced features like database migrations, secure authentication, comprehensive tests, Docker containerization, CI/CD pipeline, and basic monitoring/alerting. This project should mimic a real-world, scalable application.

resources.title: How to Build a REST API with Spring Boot (Baeldung)
Deploy a MERN Stack App to AWS with CI/CD - Full Course
Dockerizing a Node.js Application for Production - Node.js & Docker Tutorial
